protocol.scope: Controlled synthetic learning demonstration, not an additional real thesis dataset or claim about Wisconsin
protocol.task: Classify horizontal versus vertical bars in 12x12 grayscale images
protocol.foreground: Centered 2x6 horizontal or 6x2 vertical bar, random shifts of -1,0,1 pixels and bounded intensity jitter; foreground overwrites background
protocol.background: Uniform intensity 0.15 or 0.65; correlated training assigns low to horizontal and high to vertical; clean control assigns balanced independent colors
protocol.paired_control: Identical labels, foreground values, masks, and positions across test views; only background changes

cnn.architecture: Same 1->8->16 conv/ReLU/global-pool/2-logit architecture as Experiment 02; 1282 parameters

protocol.selection: Validation minimum cross-entropy in each training regime; no test feedback

explanation.examples: first eight correlated test records; targets fixed to true shape labels
explanation.baseline: paired background-only image preserving each input background; deliberately isolates added foreground
explanation.completeness: record residuals; quadrature refinement to 2048 if relative residual exceeds 0.001

outcomes: accuracy and macro-F1 per paired view
absolute IG mass inside versus outside the known foreground mask under both baselines
protocol.interpretation: Paired input changes directly test model sensitivity to controlled backgrounds. Attribution mass depends on reference and mask size; it is not a universal quality score. No architecture/hyperparameter retuning after viewing outcomes.
